items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: Well, I take off first, or either let Pearson go first.

ctx.x: Now the way you got your break, here's the deal. One man take off at a time, take half hour. One man gets three half hour breaks, but it rotates, see? Now you got two of each, see? You got two sax, you got two trumpets. Well, I take off first, or either let Pearson go first. And when he comes back, a sax will take off. Fifteen minutes, eh? Huh? Fifteen minutes or thirty? No, thirty minutes. Oh, that was a pretty good break. Yeah, yeah, yeah. And on that long night, like Saturday night, well each man would, he…
